description: VLSFO bunker fuel prices (USD per metric ton) by port and regional average from the public Ship & Bunker prices page: price, change, daily high, low and spread. Indicative public assessments, not a firm offer; ex-wharf prices exclude freight and taxes. Only the VLSFO grade is extracted. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

port.description: Optional: part of a port or region name, e.g. Singapore or EMEA. Empty returns all rows.
